en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a modernist exhibition hall building with large vertical windows and a flat roof. The facade bears the inscription "GRAZER MESSE" with a coat of arms in the center. In the foreground is an empty street, a sidewalk, lampposts and some trees. At the bottom margin the caption reads "GRAZ. MESSEHALLE." with a small photographer's credit "W. KRAMER" in the lower right corner.
